about: Document step S1 paginate fix cleanly while emitting replan_remaining so S1 commits before step-plan amends S2 based on TF1.

request.prompt: Fix paginate() in src/paginate.js so trailing partial pages work accurately and expose paginated /items in src/server.js. R-1: Return all items for trailing partial pages (Math.ceil total pages) and expose paginated /items in server.js.

work_item.title: Fix pagination and add paginated /items route
work_item.context: Fix src/paginate.js (S1) then add /items in src/server.js (S2).

step-plan.summary: Two steps: S1 fixes paginate (C1); S2 exposes paginated /items (C2).

criteria.text: paginate([1,2,3,4,5], 3, 2) returns {page: 3, pages: 3, items: [5]}. Confirm by: running node --test --reporter=spec test/paginate.test.js; pass when exit 0. Serves R-1.
GET /items returns paginated response in server.js. Confirm by: running node --test test/server.test.js; pass when exit 0. Serves R-1.

step-plan.check_na: Dependency-free Node fixture has no separate lint or build step.

learned: paginate throws RangeError for non-integer query arguments.
decisions: Keep strict Number.isInteger validation inside paginate.

test.summary: Verified TC-1 and boundary TC-1 (a); recorded TF1 noting S2 must parse and validate integer query params.

test_findings.finding: S2 server.js GET /items receives string query params and must parse/validate integer bounds before calling paginate().
test_findings.evidence: test/paginate.test.js TC-1 (a) and RangeError guard in src/paginate.js
test_findings.next_step: Emit replan_remaining at document so S1 commits and step-plan amends S2.
